$comment: Ground-truth labels. kind: violation | clean | indeterminate. expect: defect ids (see DEFECTS in run.ts), each an element-level defect a human expert would call a certain WCAG failure for this file ALONE; use {"defect": id, "count": n} for n distinct elements. acceptable: rule ids that are defensible secondary reports (never FP, never TP). cause: the static-analysis trap this case exercises (used to attribute any false positive). note: the expert reasoning.

html/v-icon-button-no-name.html.note: Icon-only button, svg has no title, no aria-label.

html/v-input-no-label.html.note: Text input with no label, aria-label, title or placeholder.

html/v-aria-attr-typo.html.note: aria-lable is not an ARIA attribute (literal typo).

html/v-positive-tabindex.html.note: tabindex=3 breaks focus order (axe tags this best-practice; counted as expected either way).

html/v-empty-link.html.note: Link whose only content is an unlabelled svg.

html/v-invalid-role.html.note: role=buton is not a valid role.

html/v-list-invalid-child.html.note: div as direct child of ul.

html/v-aria-expanded-bad-value.html.note: aria-expanded=yes is not a valid token.

html/v-two-unnamed-buttons-same-prefix.h.note: Two DISTINCT unnamed buttons whose first 80 chars of markup are identical. Tests the dedup key.

html/c-icon-button-aria-label.html.note: Icon button named by aria-label, svg aria-hidden.

html/c-decorative-img.html.note: alt="" on a decorative image is correct.

html/c-data-table.html.note: Table with caption and scoped headers.

html/c-labelledby-details.html.note: aria-labelledby points to an existing id.

html/c-marketing-prose.html.note: Dense but ordinary marketing prose. 3.1.5 Reading Level is AAA; the scan targets AA, so any 3.1.5 report is out of scope for this target.

html/c-nav-landmarks-fragment.html.note: Header fragment: named logo link (aria-label, decorative img alt=""), named nav.

html/c-two-similar-buttons.html.note: Two named buttons with identical class prefixes (control for the dedup case).

html/i-error-text-adjacent.html.note: aria-invalid=true with a visible text error right after the field. SC 3.3.1 requires the error to be identified and described in TEXT; programmatic association (aria-describedby) is not required by 3.3.1. Whether the visible text is shown for this field is a render-time fact.

jsx/v-icon-button-in-autocomplete-form.t.note: Icon-only submit button in a form whose input carries autoComplete; the label wraps the input (clean). Exercises the axe-core singleton shared with jsx-a11y's autocomplete-valid rule.

jsx/v-input-no-label.tsx.note: Literal input, no label mechanism, no spread.

jsx/v-positive-tabindex-expr.tsx.note: tabIndex={3}: a literal number inside an expression, statically certain.

jsx/v-div-onclick.tsx.note: Non-focusable div with onClick and no key handler or role: keyboard users cannot activate it.

jsx/v-checkbox-role-missing-state.tsx.note: role=checkbox with no aria-checked at all (not dynamic: absent).

jsx/v-root-layout-no-lang.tsx.note: Next.js App Router root layout with <html> and no lang. The <title> is injected by Next from `metadata`, so a document-title report is a false positive.

jsx/v-label-not-associated.tsx.note: Sibling label with no htmlFor and input with no id: not associated.

jsx/v-img-after-helper-return.tsx.note: The img is in the component; a helper function earlier in the file also uses `return (`.

jsx/v-second-component.tsx.note: The violation is in the SECOND component of the file.

jsx/v-img-in-map.tsx.note: img rendered in .map() with no alt attribute at all: statically certain whatever the data.

jsx/v-icon-button-after-arrow-handler.ts.note: Icon-only button after an element with onClick={() => fn(x)}.

jsx/c-htmlfor-literal.tsx.note: label htmlFor="email" + input id="email": correct association in React.

jsx/c-sr-only-text.tsx.note: Visually hidden text names the button.

jsx/c-root-layout-lang.tsx.note: Root layout with lang; title comes from Next `metadata`.

jsx/c-self-closing-div.tsx.note: Self-closing <div /> (valid JSX, not valid HTML) before a list.

jsx/c-classname-cn-multiline.tsx.note: Multi-line className={cn(...)} with Tailwind aria-*/data-* variants on a named button.

jsx/c-classname-template-literal.tsx.note: className via template literal containing aria-[...] variant.

jsx/c-classname-clsx-object.tsx.note: className via clsx object with aria-selected: key.

jsx/c-style-object.tsx.note: Named progressbar; aria-value* given as expressions {0} {100} {value}, style object.

jsx/i-shadcn-input.tsx.note: shadcn/ui Input: label/aria-label arrive through {...props}. Unknowable statically.

jsx/i-shadcn-button.tsx.note: shadcn/ui Button: <Comp> (Slot or button), name via children in props.

jsx/i-native-button-spread.tsx.note: Native button whose children/aria-label come via {...props}.

jsx/i-list-map.tsx.note: ul whose li come from .map() (the li is visible in source here).

jsx/i-list-children-prop.tsx.note: ul whose children come from the children prop.

jsx/i-definition-list-map.tsx.note: dl whose dt/dd come from a child component in .map().

jsx/i-radiogroup-dynamic-checked.tsx.note: role=radio with aria-checked={expr}: present at runtime.

jsx/i-link-dynamic-href-aria-label.tsx.note: <a href={url} aria-label="...">: a real link at runtime.

jsx/i-dynamic-htmlfor-id.tsx.note: useId(): htmlFor={id} + id={id}, associated at runtime.

jsx/i-custom-components-radix.tsx.note: Radix DropdownMenu + shadcn Button: rendered DOM unknown statically (and the icon-only trigger may well be unnamed at runtime - but that is not provable from this file).

jsx/i-conditional-error.tsx.note: Conditional error message with dynamic aria-invalid/aria-describedby.

jsx/i-react-hook-form-field.tsx.note: Input wrapped by its label, {...register()} spread.

jsx/i-async-server-page.tsx.note: Next.js async server page, list from .map() with template-literal href.

jsx/i-autofocus.tsx.note: autoFocus in a command-palette search: not a WCAG failure per se (no SC forbids autofocus; 2.4.3/3.2.1 are only failed by specific effects).

jsx/i-anchor-hash-onclick.tsx.note: <a href="#" onClick>: poor practice (should be a button) but keyboard-operable and named; not a certain 2.4.4 failure.

jsx/i-video-no-track.tsx.note: Muted, aria-hidden decorative loop: captions (1.2.2) apply to media with audio. Not provable either way from source.

astro/v-layout-no-lang.astro.note: Layout with <html> and no lang. <title>{title}</title> is present.

astro/v-empty-link.astro.note: Link containing only an unlabelled svg.

astro/c-layout-lang.astro.note: Complete layout with lang, title (expression), main, slot.

astro/c-label-for-literal.astro.note: Literal for/id. jsx-a11y rules look for the React prop htmlFor; Astro templates use the HTML attribute for.

vue/v-img-after-nested-template.vue.note: img without alt placed after a nested <template v-if>.
